text: So sorry to bother you this late, I'm probably being overcautious. I'm fostering a 6 year old girl and about half an hour ago she banged her head on the corner of the kitchen table. She cried straight away, then calmed down, and she's been completely normal since, I think. Wide awake, chatting to me, laughing at the telly. Her neck seems fine, she can look down at her tummy without any bother. I just wasn't sure if there's something I'm supposed to watch for overnight, I'm still quite new to this and didn't want to get it wrong. Thank you and sorry again
